title: Transformative Innovation in the delivery of Assisted Living Products and Services (TIDAL)

image.alt: People chatting. Two are standing and one is sitting in a wheelchair. The Tidal logo can be seen in the right bottom corner

summary: TIDAL brought together research and practice to improve how assisted-living products and services are developed and delivered. The EPSRC-funded network ran from January 2022 to December 2024.
